observations.tail_of_two_cats: Unferth/Hild and the 5-death-rune enchant, three roaming Bob conversations, Gertrude/Reldo/Sphinx, eight distinct chores, medical hat alternatives, water disguise and reward lamps.
observations.ratcatchers: Four quest sections: sisters and eight sewer rats, stealth mansion and six rats, Jack's poison/Pox cure/King rat, Smokin' Joe and the Port Sarim/Pollnivneach snake charm finale.
observations.prerequisite: Both quests depend on Icthlarin's Little Helper. Ratcatchers only needs The Giant Dwarf started for Keldagrim access. Both share the existing pet kitten and either form of catspeak amulet.
observations.travel: Each local mansion, warehouse, sewer, Burthorpe and rat-pit location is linked to an existing world waypoint. Four Rat Pits grouping destinations use the shared 20-minute minigame teleport cooldown from three representative waypoints.
observations.museum: Historian Minas gives five additional kudos for Bob's Robert the Strong history after A Tail of Two Cats, claimed separately.
